name: Career Girl no Yuuwaku
original_name: キャリアガールの誘惑
source:
The story revolves around erotic images sent to a cell phone. A woman sends pictures of her private parts to the cell phone of a salaryman like me. That woman is actually my boss. Trapped in her hot, wet, and lustful garden, I end up working overtime every day in the name of pleasure.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/208421/]Getchu[/url]]
